title: Pork Tenderloin with Zesty Herb Crust
description: A classic French dish with a zesty twist, featuring a tender pork tenderloin topped with a flavorful herb crust.

ingredients.name: Zesty herbs
ingredients.notes: chopped fresh parsley, thyme, and rosemary

instructions: Rinse the pork tenderloin and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the zesty herbs, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Dredge the pork tenderloin in the zesty herb mixture, coating it evenly.
Dip the coated pork tenderloin in the Polish breadcrumbs, pressing the crumbs onto the meat to help them stick.
Place the pork tenderloin on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pork tenderloin in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the pork tenderloin rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly and serving.
